CustomField.label: Stage Entry Date
CustomField.description: The date this deal ENTERED its current stage. Stamped by Apex (OpportunityStageEntryService) on every genuine stage transition. Re-stamped, not preserved, on re-entry - the clock restarts. Feeds Days_In_Stage__c and the Item 4 stalled-deal reminder.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically when the deal's stage changes. Do not edit unless correcting a known data error.
